name: Mamiya Maria
source:
She is Marie's beloved daughter and has inherited her mother's beauty.

She is a self-proclaimed "reprinted" beautiful daughter. As the youngest daughter, she is very much loved, and perhaps because of her pampered upbringing, she has an extremely selfish and winsome personality.

Because of this personality, most of the tutors she hires do not last long.

[From [url=https://www.empress-game.com/title.html]official site[/url]]
